subject: Pilot upgrade: phased credits & feature enablement for Novacorp
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Tom Wallace <tom.w@novacorp.com>, Sana Patel <sana@clearpoint.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 09:12:07 -0800
Subject: Pilot upgrade: phased credits & feature enablement for Novacorp

Tom / Sana —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion I wanted to put two concrete packaging options on the table for the pilot upgrade so procurement can evaluate next steps. Short ask: can you confirm which approach you prefer and the target PO/contract date so we can align legal and billing?

Options (high level):
- Option A — Immediate feature enablement + front-loaded credit: New tier enabled day 1; we apply a one-time credit equal to 30% of the upgrade commitment at activation, remainder billed as usual. Pros: fastest time-to-value. Cons: larger early credit.
- Option B — Phased credit + milestone gating: Enable core features day 1, advanced features after 60–90 days; split credits so 40% applied at activation, 60% after milestone is met. Pros: reduces early credit exposure; aligns incentives.

Example numbers included in the attached redwood-upgrade-options.pdf.

Other items we need from Novacorp to finalize:
- Procurement target date
- Whether Novacorp requires the full SOW to be attached to an amendment (we can provide a short-form amendment template)
- Any constraints on quarter-end billing or invoice terms

If either option works, we’ll have legal draft the amendment and Ben will coordinate the billing timeline.

Thanks — happy to hop on another quick call if helpful.

— Kimberly Park
Principal Account Lead
Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-upgrade-options.pdf (summary of options and numeric examples)

From: Tom Wallace <tom.w@novacorp.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Sana Patel <sana@clearpoint.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 11:03:45 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot upgrade: phased credits & feature enablement for Novacorp

Kimberly —

Appreciate the clear options. A couple clarifying questions from procurement and our product team:
1) If we go with Option A, will all paid features be enabled immediately for all pilot users, or do you gate advanced features behind the milestone stated in Option B? We need feature timing spelled out for our compliance review.
2) For Option B, what counts as the 60–90 day milestone? Is that usage-based (token threshold) or calendar-based?

Procurement also asked for a draft SOW to attach to the amendment — I’ve attached a short SOW draft (Novacorp-SOW-draft.pdf) that shows the pilot scope. Our preferred PO target is March 18, 2027. If you can get amendment language to legal by Feb 20, that would be ideal.

Thanks,
Tom Wallace
Director, Platform Integrations
Novacorp

Attachment: Novacorp-SOW-draft.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Tom Wallace <tom.w@novacorp.com>, Sana Patel <sana@clearpoint.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 13:20:10 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot upgrade: phased credits & feature enablement for Novacorp

Tom —

Quick answers:
- Feature gating: If you select Option A we’ll enable the full feature set immediately for the pilot cohort. Option B allows us to stage enablement (core features day 1, advanced features after the milestone). We can call out the exact feature flags in the amendment so your compliance team has a checklist.

- Milestone definition: We recommend a calendar-based milestone (90 days from activation) to keep invoicing simple, but we can switch to a usage threshold if you prefer — let us know which you’d like.

Credit structure proposal (concrete):
- Activation credit: 40% of upgrade commitment applied as a billing credit on the first invoice.
- Post-milestone credit: Remaining 60% applied after the 90-day milestone (or after the agreed usage threshold).

Rationale: the 40/60 split balances Novacorp’s desire to reduce upfront cash flow burden with Redwood’s need to minimize early revenue leakage. I’ve attached a one-page amendment-template.docx you can use; legal can swap language if needed.

If procurement needs a different split we can consider 50/50, but that will slightly change the unit economics we show in the attached pricing examples.

— Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachment: amendment-template.docx

From: Sana Patel <sana@clearpoint.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Tom Wallace <tom.w@novacorp.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 17:05:22 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot upgrade: phased credits & feature enablement for Novacorp

Ben / Team —

Thanks — Novacorp prefers a cleaner billing cadence. Procurement is inclined to a 50/50 credit split (50% at activation, 50% after 90 days) to avoid adding paperwork to their quarter close. They also want immediate access to the full feature set for the pilot (Option A behavior) but are happy to include a success checkpoint at 90 days to release the second credit.

Next steps from our side:
- Novacorp procurement to issue PO by March 18 (tentative)
- Please share the formal amendment and pricing worksheet so our finance team can model the impact.

I’m attaching the price sheet Novacorp wants filled out so they can approve internally.

— Sana Patel
Program Manager (on behalf of Novacorp)

Attachment: Novacorp-price-sheet.xlsx

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 10:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot upgrade: phased credits & feature enablement for Novacorp

All —

50/50 compromise is acceptable from ops and finance if Novacorp signs the PO by March 18. I’ll loop legal (Laura) to start an amendment draft this afternoon and will push the pricing worksheet to finance for completion.

Kimberly — can you confirm the exact feature flags we’ll enable day 1 so Laura can reference them in the amendment?

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
